example.title: Sprague Bridge (9th Street Bridge), Ninth Street East over the Yellow River
example.place: between Armenia and Necedah, Juneau County, WI

brief: Two-span pin-connected steel Pratt half-hip pony truss, 1913, each span 58 ft 8 in (121 ft 7 in overall), 15 ft roadway and 5 ft 4 in web height, built-up angle and channel members with riveted gussets. Bituminous surface on a corrugated metal deck over rolled I-beam floor beams and stringers; the trusses bear on metal-capped steel tube piers inside steel sheet retaining walls at the abutments and the central pier. Low lattice-and-angle rail along the trusses; striped hazard boards at the ends. Crosses a shallow sandy river in open woods on a narrow town street.

traits.abutments: steel tube piers with steel sheet retaining walls
